Causa instituti hujus fuit, quòd credere-tur, collegium primum rebus omnibus, quæ illi çommissæ erant, non sufficere. Sedent in eo duo à senatu oppidano dati è civium numero, duo ab ordinibus agrariis ex eorundem medio. Defignantur in comitiis. Curatio eorum annua, nisi fiat prorogatio, quæ fit sæpè. Duo ex his, alter ex oppidanis ex agrariis alter,actorum & rationum indices aut libros tenentur conficere, capiuntque stipendium è publico Carolinos aureos ccc; cæteri verò cc tantùm. page.notes: Marginal "Quæstorcs" is a poor scan; the note reads "Quæstores bonorum monasticorum" as split over four margin lines. Marks "cc" in the margin are section or catch marks, transcribed as printed. Small stray marks in the right margin near the bottom are show-through or dust and were left out. The bottom right corner shows a digitiser's watermark, left out. Doubtful words: "çommissæ" (the ç may be a printing flaw), "Quæstorcs" (for Quæstores).
